Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000563": On 2025-07-17, Yuki Tanaka handed the Cinder pager to Diego on rotation day.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)

- memory_id "1000424": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000420": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)

- memory_id "1000306" [constraint]: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000294" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000281" [decision]: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000183" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000180" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000152": Oskar runs the weekly architecture review.  (about: Oskar, weekly architecture review)
- memory_id "1000140": The Ember team owns the authentication gateway.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000105": Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000094": The Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
